about: SHARD-PLATFORM SF6: immutable physical TypeScript-line baseline from SP5 (the old ratio is now labelled legacy TS). Converted shards must reach public SDK share >=80 % and hold their logical runtime/ line ceiling <=20 % of this baseline. Ceilings only fall (scripts/shard-platform.mjs). A shard joins enforced at its conversion row (SF46–SF51); Thin Ice (SF53) at its first commit. Milestone proofs follow test/proof/<slug>/ (scripts/README.md).
